_meta.description: Thresholds and prompt contract for the mid-AC commit checkpoint in /work Step 3 (#2557). Externalized so the values can be tuned without a spec edit (#2318 precedent).

checkpoint.description: Fires DURING an acceptance criterion, before its deliverable is complete. The commit-per-deliverable gate has no trigger mid-AC, so a long investigative phase accumulates uncommitted work until the next commit sweeps it up under a message attributing it to the wrong issue.
checkpoint.onDecline: proceed with work unchanged; do not re-prompt for the same accumulation without further delta

trigger.measurement: git diff --numstat HEAD (working tree against the last commit)

thresholds.rationale: Routine single-AC work touches 1-3 files. Eight is well clear of that, so the prompt stays rare in the common case.

The motivating incident reached 591 insertions in one uncommitted session, so this fires roughly midway through work of that shape. Deliberately late rather than chatty: a prompt that fires too often is felt in every deployed project.

prompt.text: You have accumulated {changedFiles} changed file(s) and {insertions} insertion(s) since the last commit, still inside the current AC. Name the verified milestone reached so far and commit it now, or decline to continue.
prompt.why: The delta decides WHEN to ask; the answer supplies WHAT the commit message says. A mechanical trigger alone would catch the uncommitted-work half of the incident and leave the bad-commit-message half untouched.

checkpoint.reset: Any commit clears the accumulation; the next evaluation measures from the new HEAD.

distinctFromNonstopAudit.thisMeasures: volume accumulated within one AC - changedFiles and insertions since the last commit
distinctFromNonstopAudit.auditMeasures: commits per AC across a completed run - Math.ceil(acCount / 3)
distinctFromNonstopAudit.note: Different units, so no single number satisfies both. This checkpoint is live and fires during work; the audit is post-hoc, warning-only, and scoped to epic/--nonstop runs. The audit is deliberately left unchanged (#2557 AC5).
